content: केस(श)रिन् {%m.%} [केस(श)र-इनि] .²1 A lion; अनुहुंकुरुते घनध्वनिं न हि गोमायुरुतानि केसरी <ls>Śi. 16. 25</ls>; धनुर्धरः केसरिणं ददर्श <ls>R. 2. 29</ls>; <ls>Ś. 7. 3</ls>. .²2 The best, excellent, or most prominent of a class (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>); <ab>cf.</ab> कुञ्जर, सिंह <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 A horse; <ls>Mb. 12. 78. 4</ls>. .²4 The citron plant. .²5 The Punnāga tree. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of the father of Hanūmat. .{@-रिणी@} A lioness; <ls>Ks. 70. 102</ls>.
